description: The warehouse CRM quotations and their sales orders use, per branch.

fields.description: Per branch: the warehouse every CRM quotation and sales order line uses, and the print formats the CRM's Print button uses. The Item's own warehouse is ignored. No row for a branch means quotations for it are refused.
fields.label: Branch Warehouses

fields.description: Reference only. The dates that actually block quotations are the rows in the table below.
fields.label: Holiday List

fields.description: Dates on which quotations cannot be created. Tick the branches the holiday applies to; a row with no branch ticked blocks every branch.
fields.label: Holiday List Table

fields.description: Hours of the day a branch may create documents. A row counts only for the documents it ticks: Quotation rows gate quotations, Sales Order rows gate sales orders. A branch with no Quotation row ticked has no time limit on quotations.
fields.label: Time Setting Branch Wise

fields.description: Weekdays on which each branch may create quotations. Untick a day to block it for that branch. Checked after the holiday check and before the time check.
fields.label: Week Days

name: CRM Custom Settings
